verdict.rationale: Canva's docs only show automated design resizing, which creates new versions of a design in different dimensions, formats, or aspect ratios. That is adjacent to the story but not the same as frames that reflow responsively. Nothing in the evidence covers auto layout, constraints, or layout grids. Missing for 10: auto layout behavior, resizing constraints, responsive layout grids, frames that flex live like real UIs, and hands-on corroboration.
